Future fact —> I will be 30 next week.

Your father does not pay me to help you.
Kindengarden = ?
Shared knowledge —> will
Worksheet: —> check grammar and form and vocabulary 
I will call you as soon as I get home tonight because I want to tell you what happened at the interview and get your opinion before I make any final decision. —> a decision mad at the moment of speaking. —> cause “of I will call”.
The new shopping center will open next Friday at 9 a.m., and the first 500 customers will receive a free gift, according to the official announcement. —> a fixed plan, timetable, scheduled event, or future fact. —> cause of “shopping center will open” —> announcement = ?/according = ?
Don’t worry about carrying all those heavy bags yourself — I’ll help you take them to the car before I leave. —> an offer or promise — saying that you are willing to do something or promising to do it. —> cause of “I will help”
If we don’t leave the office soon, we might miss the beginning of the film because the traffic is usually tribble around this time. —> possibility — something is possible, but we are not sure —> cause of “might”
I’m not completely sure yet, but Sarah may move to another city next year because she has been offered a much better job there. —> possibility — something is possible, but we are not sure —> cause of “may”
May I use your laptop for a few minutes? I need to check something for my presentation, and my phone is not working properly. —> a polite/formal request or asking for permission —> cause of “may”
As you may know, our school is planning to introduce a new English course next semester, so there will be some changes to the way our class are organized. —> talking about shared knowledge — something the listener probably already knows. —> cause of “as yo mat know”
